SECTION.TITLE: 1. Acceptance of Terms
SECTION.CONTENT: By registering as a user of the database of the Network of the University of Málaga (hereinafter, UMA) and the Sociedad Malagueña de Astronomía (hereinafter, SMA), you agree to fully comply with these Terms and Conditions. By accessing or using the services, resources, or digital platforms (such as the website, forums, databases, etc.), you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and accepted these Terms and Conditions in their entirety. If you do not agree with any of these terms, please do not register or use the services of the UMA/SMA Network.

SECTION.TITLE: 2. Membership and User Registration
SECTION.CONTENT: To access the UMA/SMA Network database, you must register. You agree to provide true, accurate, current, and complete information during the registration process. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your password and account and are fully responsible for all activities that occur under your account.

SECTION.TITLE: 3. Data Usage and Citation Requirement
SECTION.CONTENT: The SMA may provide users with various data, information, materials, images, observations, calculations, and project results (hereinafter, "the Data") through its platforms, activities, or publications. THE USE OF ANY OF THESE DATA BY THE USER—WHETHER FOR RESEARCH, OUTREACH, PUBLICATIONS (PRINTED OR DIGITAL), PRESENTATIONS, ACADEMIC WORKS, OR ANY OTHER PURPOSE—MUST BE CLEARLY CITED, EXPRESSLY ACKNOWLEDGING THE UMA/SMA NETWORK AS THE SOURCE. The recommended citation format is: "Data provided by the Network of the University of Málaga and the Sociedad Malagueña de Astronomía" or a similar mention that clearly identifies the UMA/SMA Network as the data source. In scientific or academic publications, a full reference to the specific source should be included if available (e.g., specific SMA publication or project). This citation requirement applies regardless of the quantity or format of the data used. Failure to comply with this citation obligation may result in the review or revocation of your membership or access to UMA/SMA Network resources.

SECTION.TITLE: 4. Intellectual Property
SECTION.CONTENT: UMA and SMA retain all intellectual property rights over the content, logos, designs, and materials they generate, unless expressly stated otherwise. The use of Data in accordance with clause 3 does not transfer any ownership rights to the user, beyond a usage license under the citation condition. Users who contribute content, data, or other materials to the UMA/SMA Network for potential dissemination or use in UMA or SMA activities grant UMA and SMA a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, reproduce, modify, adapt, publish, translate, distribute, and display such content in connection with the Network's purposes, provided that original authorship is acknowledged when applicable and feasible.

SECTION.TITLE: 5. Privacy and Data Protection
SECTION.CONTENT: SMA will collect and process your personal data in accordance with current data protection legislation. The main purpose of processing your data is the management of your membership or registration, the organization of activities, and internal communication within the Society. Your data will not be shared with third parties without your express consent, except where legally required. You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, cancellation, objection, restriction, and data portability by contacting the SMA Secretariat (secretaria@astromalaga.es). For more details on how your data is processed, please consult our Privacy Policy [if a separate Privacy Policy document exists, insert link or indication of where to find it].

SECTION.TITLE: 6. Limitation of Liability
SECTION.CONTENT: UMA and SMA strive to provide accurate and up-to-date information and resources, but do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or suitability of the Data for any particular purpose. UMA and SMA are not responsible for any damages or losses that may result from the use of the Data.

SECTION.TITLE: 7. Modifications to the Terms
SECTION.CONTENT: The UMA/SMA Network reserves the right to modify these Terms and Conditions at any time. Users will be notified of any significant changes. Continued use of the UMA/SMA Network services after such modifications constitutes your acceptance of the new terms.

SECTION.TITLE: 8. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
SECTION.CONTENT: These Terms and Conditions shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Spain. Any disputes arising in relation to these terms shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Málaga.

SECTION.TITLE: 9. Contact
